items.name: Top bar
items.note: Same job and tokens; each platform draws its native bar.

items.name: Section tabs
items.note: Same job; native tab strip per platform.

items.name: Bottom tab bar
items.ios_today: UITabBar · tabbar, tabactive, tabinactive; FA icons 26×23
items.android_today: Bottom navigation · bar, navactive, bartext; 24dp icons
items.note: Android always uses the nav bar color; iOS too except BS.

items.name: Breaking-news banner
items.note: One component, one Core alert color (PLAT-03).

items.name: Section header band
items.note: No band on Android. Equals navbar in 66/77 markets.

items.name: Status bar color
items.note: Equals navbar in 70/77 markets.

items.name: Primary button
items.ios_today: Paywall Log In / Register · action fill, white Open Sans Bold 14 caps, radius 4 (legacy 5 + 1pt border)
items.android_today: Paywall Subscribe · action fill, white caps system font, 60dp tall, square
items.note: One Core primary button. Differences to decide: radius (4 vs 0), height, font.

items.name: Continue button
items.ios_today: Continue-* PNGs (10 market copies); tracking-consent Continue has the only disabled state
items.android_today: Your News Continue 152×54 radius 9; What's New Continue radius 6
items.note: Same job as Primary button; recommend it becomes Primary button, not its own component.

items.name: Subscription option
items.ios_today: subscriptionTintColor, Open Sans Bold 16, radius 8, inset 16
items.android_today: buy fill, white 16sp (Monthly bold), square, 14dp padding
items.note: Fill = action on both (PLAT-04). Differences: radius, font.

items.name: Text link button
items.note: Core text/link button.

items.name: Notification prompt buttons
items.note: Same job; iOS has a Yes/No pair.

items.name: Manage subscription / delete account
items.note: Only place Android has an outlined (secondary) button.

items.name: Savings label
items.android_today: White, 2dp stroke in buy color, radius 15
items.note: Not on iOS paywall.

items.name: Social sign-in buttons
items.android_today: Native buttons exist but are hidden; login is Auth0's web page
items.note: Android shows them only on the Auth0 web page.

items.name: Secondary, disabled, loading states
items.note: Gap on both. Define once in Core (CTRL-02).

items.name: Switch
items.ios_today: UISwitch; 4 tint tokens, nil = iOS green
items.android_today: SwitchCompat; accent on alert topics, Material default in Settings
items.note: One Core on-color token (PLAT-10); native control per platform.

items.name: Checkbox (Your News topics)
items.note: One Core checkbox tinted by token; removes iOS image sets.

items.name: Text size setting
items.note: Same job, different control. Core: the scale steps; platform: the control.

items.name: Segmented control
items.note: Native control per platform; Core sets colors.

items.name: Loading indicator
items.note: Same pattern on both; no in-button spinner.

items.name: Section-front grid
items.note: Identical.

items.name: Cell spacing
items.note: Same values, different names. Core: 16 / 8.

items.name: Breakpoints
items.note: Same job, different units. Core names the classes; platforms set thresholds (LAY-01).

items.name: Article side margin
items.note: Both 16 on phones.

items.name: Minimum touch target
items.note: Core rule; platform value.

items.name: Orientation
items.note: Identical.
